name: security-audit-skill
description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
one_liner: A plug-in playbook that turns an AI coding assistant into a structured security auditor, finding and double-checking vulnerabilities in a codebase.
buyer: An independent penetration tester or boutique security consultancy that wants to cut audit time without hiring more analysts.
business_use_cases: A freelance pentester runs this skill against a client's codebase before kickoff, delivering a first-pass vulnerability list in hours instead of days of manual review.
A security consultancy wires it into its standard engagement pipeline as the always-on first pass, so human reviewers only triage already-verified findings.
A SaaS company with no dedicated security team runs it quarterly on its own repo as a cheap, in-house pre-audit before paying for an external pentest.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'pre-audit' service: run the skill against a client's repo and sell the structured findings report as a fixed-price deliverable before they commit to a full manual engagement.
Package it as the backbone of a subscription 'continuous security review' service that re-runs on every release and alerts on new findings.

steal_this: Wrap this skill in a simple web form: paste a GitHub URL, get a structured vulnerability report back in an hour, charge a flat fee per scan.
